subject: Computer Graphics and Visualization

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Introduction to Computer Graphics and Display Hardware
questions.text: Explain Video Display Devices: Cathode Ray Tube (CRT), Refresh Cathode Ray Tubes, Raster Scan Display vs Random Scan (Vector) Display systems in terms of architecture, frame buffer, and refresh rate.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Scan Conversion and Line/Circle Drawing Algorithms
questions.text: Explain DDA (Digital Differential Analyzer) Line Drawing Algorithm. Derive Bresenham's Line Drawing Algorithm for $|m| < 1$. Trace Bresenham's algorithm to rasterize a line from $(2, 3)$ to $(10, 8)$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Scan Conversion and Line/Circle Drawing Algorithms
questions.text: Derive Midpoint Circle Drawing Algorithm using 8-way symmetry. Calculate pixel coordinates to draw a circle with radius $r = 10$ centered at origin $(0, 0)$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Two-Dimensional Geometric Transformations and Viewing/Clipping
questions.text: Explain 2D Affine Transformations: Translation, Rotation about origin, Scaling, Reflection, and Shear in Homogeneous Coordinate matrix representation. Perform 2D Composite Transformation: Rotate triangle $A(1,1), B(4,1), C(2,3)$ by $45^\circ$ about arbitrary point $P(2,2)$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Two-Dimensional Geometric Transformations and Viewing/Clipping
questions.text: Explain Cohen-Sutherland Line Clipping Algorithm (4-bit Outcodes: Top, Bottom, Right, Left). Clip the line segment $P_1(10, 20)$ to $P_2(80, 90)$ against the rectangular window $W(x_{min}=20, y_{min}=20, x_{max}=60, y_{max}=60)$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Two-Dimensional Geometric Transformations and Viewing/Clipping
questions.text: Explain Liang-Barsky Line Clipping Algorithm using parametric equations. Explain Sutherland-Hodgman Polygon Clipping Algorithm (Left, Right, Bottom, Top clippers).
Explain 3D Transformations: 3D Translation, 3D Scaling, and 3D Rotation about arbitrary axis in space in $4 \times 4$ homogeneous matrix form.

Explain Projections in 3D Viewing: Parallel Projections (Orthographic, Axonometric, Isometric, Oblique Cavalier/Cabinet) vs Perspective Projections (1-point, 2-point, 3-point vanishing points). Derive Perspective Projection Transformation Matrix.

Explain Bezier Curves and B-Spline Curves. State properties of Bezier Curves (Convex Hull property, Affine Invariance). Construct cubic Bezier curve for given 4 control points $P_0, P_1, P_2, P_3$ using Bernstein Polynomials: $P(u) = \sum_{k=0}^n B_{k,n}(u) P_k$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Visible Surface Detection and Illumination/Shading Models
questions.text: Explain Visible Surface Detection (Hidden Surface Removal) Algorithms: (a) Depth-Buffer (Z-Buffer) Algorithm, (b) A-Buffer Algorithm, (c) Depth-Sort (Painter's) Algorithm, and (d) Back-Face Culling.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Visible Surface Detection and Illumination/Shading Models
questions.text: Explain Illumination Models: Ambient light, Diffuse reflection (Lambert's Cosine Law: $I_{diff} = I_p K_d \cos\theta$), and Specular reflection (Phong Model: $I_{spec} = I_p K_s \cos^n\phi$). Compare Flat Shading vs Gouraud Shading (Intensity Interpolation) vs Phong Shading (Normal Vector Interpolation).
